DESIGN + DEVELOPMENT

Your Roadster.
In motion.

Website and cinematic interaction design by Yash Patel. The exterior model and original texture maps come from the supplied tesla-roadster-20.zip asset.

The same uploaded vehicle appears in the showroom, close-ups and every frame of the stunt. The four original wheel assemblies rotate independently.

The asset contains one connected exterior body shell. It does not include separately rigged hood or door panels, or a modeled cockpit. Front and canopy views are exterior inspections.

Cold-gas plumes and the stunt trajectory are added artistic effects, not validated vehicle physics.

Independent portfolio concept. Not affiliated with Tesla or SpaceX. Model authorship is separate from website authorship. Three.js and its model loader are used under the MIT license.
